wiki.title: Aaron Kaufman (politician)
wiki.extract: Aaron M. Kaufman (born February 15, 1987) is an American politician and disability rights advocate. A member of the Democratic Party, he is a member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 18 in Montgomery County. Kaufman has cerebral palsy, and is the first member of the Maryland General Assembly with a physical disability.
